description: Best track 34-, 50- and 64-kt wind radii polygons for Hurricane Melissa (AL132025) at each 6-hourly synoptic time (103 polygons), with quadrant extents NE/SE/SW/NW in nautical miles. Derived column synoptic_time (UTC). NHC: "The working best track wind radii will generally not exactly match the radii contained in the tropical cyclone advisories."

table:columns.name: RADII
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The wind speed in knots associated with the bounding polygon': 34 (45 rows), 50 (31), 64 (27).

table:columns.name: STORMID
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'A unique character string ... BBNNYYYY' -> al132025.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): basin code, lower-case 'al' in the radii files.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13).

table:columns.name: ADVNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): advisory number; 0 on every best-track row (not tied to one advisory).

table:columns.name: SYNOPTIME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'Initial time in the forecast cycle in which a tropical cyclones intensity and size are analyzed, occurring at 0000, 0600, 1200, or 1800 UTC' (YYYYMMDDHH). Parsed into synoptic_time.

table:columns.name: TIMEZONE
table:columns.description: NHC (undocumented field): time zone of SYNOPTIME; 'UTC'.

table:columns.name: NE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the NE (0 - 90 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: SE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the SE (90 - 180 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: SW
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the SW (180 - 270 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: NW
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The largest distance of wind speed in Nautical Miles in the NW (270 - 360 degree) quadrant.'

table:columns.name: synoptic_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): SYNOPTIME parsed to UTC; 2025-10-21 06:00 to 2025-11-01 06:00 UTC.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Quadrant-wise wind-extent polygon (all valid) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); extent -79.99, 12.60, -40.72, 51.09.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
